# drone-14194694

Seven frames (0.0–4.0 s at 1.5 fps, scaled to 960×540, JPEG) of the drone clip the Walk the block solve was proven on:
Pexels video 14194694 by Danilo Riba (https://www.pexels.com/video/14194694/), used under the Pexels licence
(free to use and modify, no attribution required; credited here anyway). Made with
`ffmpeg -t 4.4 -i 14194694.mp4 -vf "fps=1.5,scale=960:-2" -q:v 5 f%02d.jpg`.
